answer: An agent market for bridge inspections, trellis design and karst surveys grants one job slot per 100 tokens locked for 30 days, with no free allowance per identity. Creating a thousand names therefore creates no extra capacity: an attacker must lock 100,000 tokens to occupy a thousand slots. Splitting funds among fake agents cannot increase their total allocation, and sustaining a swarm ties up capital the attacker could otherwise spend or invest.
